PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience spanning ETL development, data governance, and data quality across insurance and 
financial services. Skilled in metadata management, data quality frameworks, data cataloging, and data lineage documentation, 
with hands-on experience supporting a large-scale legacy data warehouse migration from Teradata to Google Cloud Platform 
(GCP). Strong foundation in SQL, ETL pipelines (Informatica IICS), and Power BI reporting, with a growing focus on cloud-
native data governance practices. Actively building skills in AI-driven data engineering, including Python for automation, 
GenAI/LLM concepts, and applying AI-assisted approaches to data quality and metadata workflows. Proven track record of 
partnering with Data Stewards and Architects to strengthen enterprise data trust, and of improving data accuracy and pipeline 
efficiency for business intelligence solutions.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Data Governance • Metadata Management • Data Cataloging • Data Lineage • Data Quality • Data Profiling • ETL/ELT 
Development • Data Integration • Data Modeling • Data Warehousing • Cloud Migration • Schema Mapping • Business Glossary 
& Data Dictionary • SQL • Python • AI/GenAI & LLM Fundamentals • AI-Assisted Data Quality • Stakeholder Communication • 
Agile Delivery • BFSI & Insurance Domain
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Data Management Analyst | Wells Fargo Feb 2025 – Present
Hyderabad, India
• Support enterprise data governance initiatives by managing metadata across critical data assets, improving data cataloging, 
traceability, and lineage documentation.
• Design and execute data quality checks and validation rules to monitor accuracy, completeness, and consistency of key data 
elements across source and target systems.
• Contribute to a large-scale migration of the enterprise data warehouse from Teradata to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), 
including schema mapping analysis, data validation, and reconciliation between legacy and cloud environments.
• Partner with Data Stewards, Data Architects, and business teams to define and maintain governance policies, metadata 
standards, and business glossary / data dictionary entries.
• Document data quality issues and governance gaps, driving remediation with cross-functional teams to strengthen enterprise 
data trust and compliance.
Software Engineer | Cognizant Sep 2021 – Dec 2024
Hyderabad, India

and sales data integration projects.
• Implemented error handling and logging mechanisms to monitor and resolve data migration issues, and automated ETL
